title: SpaceX scores another $950 million from NASA for 3 more crewed flights to ISS
summary: SpaceX has secured a significant extension to its existing contract with NASA, amounting to $950 million. This funding will facilitate three additional crewed Dragon flights to the International Space Station (ISS). The agreement underscores the ongoing collaboration between SpaceX and NASA in advancing space exploration and maintaining a continuous human presence in low Earth orbit. The additional flights are expected to enhance scientific research and international cooperation in space missions.
